I've created the complete CHIP-8 emulator in `chip8_ollama-glm-4.7-flash-latest_01.html`. The file includes:

**Core Emulator Features:**
- 4 KB memory with font set at 0x050 and program execution at 0x200
- 16 8-bit registers V0-VF
- 16-bit index register (I)
- Program counter (PC), call stack (SP)
- Delay and sound timers counting down at 60 Hz
- Complete 35-instruction set implementation:
  - Arithmetic and logic with carry/borrow flags in VF
  - Shift instructions
  - Jumps and calls
  - Random instruction (RND)
  - BCD conversion
  - Register save/load (LD [I], Vx and LD Vx, [I])
  - Key tests (SKP/SKNP)
- 64x32 display with XOR sprite drawing and collision detection
- 16-key keypad mapped to visible 4x4 button block

**UI & Controls:**
- Real-time display canvas (scaled for readability)
- Run/Pause/Step/Reset buttons
- Adjustable speed slider (1-100 instructions per frame)
- Load ROM from local file
- Interactive keypad with both mouse and keyboard support
- Full debugger panel showing registers, I, PC, stack, current instruction, and flags

**Demo ROM:**
- Built-in byte array with a program that draws animated sprites and reacts to key presses
- No download required to test

The emulator is fully self-contained with no external dependencies. Open the HTML file in any modern browser to run it.

sixteen 8-bit registers V0 to VF, the 16-bit index register, the program counter, a call stack, and the
delay and sound timers counting down at 60 Hz. Decode and execute the complete instruction set of 35
instructions, including the arithmetic and logic group with the carry and borrow flags in VF, the shift
instructions, jumps and calls, the random instruction, BCD conversion, register save and load, and the key
tests.

the collision flag set in VF. The 16-key keypad is mapped to a 4 by 4 block of keyboard keys shown in the
interface; key press and release must both reach the emulator.

Include a small demo ROM as a byte array inside the file: a real program, assembled by you, that draws a
sprite and moves or reacts to a key, so that the emulator can be tried without any download. Also allow
loading a ROM from a local file.

Add run, pause, single step and reset controls, an adjustable instructions-per-frame speed, and a debugger
panel showing the registers, the index register, the program counter, the stack and the decoded current
instruction. Every visible control must work. Deliver the one file `chip8_ollama-glm-4.7-flash-latest_01.html`.
